in_hebrew.name: Gosselin
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Gosselin הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Gosselin is derived from the Old German word ‘gos’, meaning ‘goose’, and ‘lin’, meaning ‘farmer’. The name likely originated from the term ‘goswyn’, meaning ‘goose friend’, and was common among farmers due to their use of geese for protection and food.
